context_requirements: Functional NMDA receptor complex (GRIN1 plus GRIN2 subunits) or other ionotropic/metabotropic glutamate receptors
Membrane depolarization or ligand-gated calcium entry competent to activate downstream signaling
Proliferative drive that can be attenuated by glutamate receptor blockade
falsifiers: No change in any of the nine cell lines at 6 h or 24 h for proliferation or apoptosis landmark genes
Strong and consistent upregulation of proliferation markers (e.g., CCND1, MYC, PCNA) at 24 h
No differential response between cell lines despite expected differences in glutamate receptor expression

evidence.supports: NMDA receptor channel blockers MK-801 and memantine decrease melanoma cell proliferation, whereas AMPA/kainate antagonist NBQX does not
Neonatal MK-801 exposure induces apoptosis in rat forebrain, indicating NMDA receptor blockade can trigger apoptotic transcriptional programs
MK-801 causes neurodegeneration and oxidative stress in mice, supporting potential stress/apoptosis gene changes
